sol.01: Default is checked in the two-row Profile menu above Preview app, with the battery card pinned to the sidebar footer.
sol.02: Haptic Sense Panel is numbered 6 on the MX Master 4 thumb rest. Additional button 1 sits below the diagram with Control ID 0x01FF.
sol.03: Close tab shows Ctrl and W as separate keycaps inside the Back button's right-aligned control.
sol.04: Common has a checkmark in the open Category menu, which pairs icons with right-aligned action counts.
sol.05: No matching actions appears directly beneath the query, followed by Record a keyboard shortcut.
sol.06: Switch wheel mode has an amber Assign button. Switch pointer speed has a neutral Set up button and a chevron.
sol.07: K saved for Back button appears next to a green check in the lower-right corner while the Back button card displays K.

terra.11: Disconnected: device card says saved button mappings are still editable.
terra.12: HID++ features: named hexadecimal IDs appear above unnamed feature chips and Copy IDs.

terra.01: Buttons: Default profile dropdown opens to Preview app above numbered mouse artwork.
terra.02: Haptic Sense Panel: MX Master 4 artwork has marker 6 and an additional reported button row.
terra.03: Gesture button tap: compact mapping list shows Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View.
terra.04: Back button: category menu lists Common, Edit, Tabs & windows, Navigation, System and Media.
terra.05: No matching actions: empty search result offers Record a keyboard shortcut.
terra.06: Switch pointer speed: two DPI sliders appear above Save pointer speed action.
terra.07: Save shortcut: recorded K appears on the Back button row with a green confirmation toast.
terra.08: SmartShift: selected wheel mode uses an amber radio and border, above sensitivity sliders.
terra.09: Tap vs. swipe threshold: slider reads 60 counts above five gesture rows.

astra.01: Buttons. Amber selection stripe marks the sidebar item, while the top-right Profile menu shows Default with a check and Preview app below it in both themes.
astra.02: Other reported buttons. MX Master 4 has six numbered artwork markers, and Additional button 1 sits in a separate bottom row with Control ID 0x01FF and Edit action.
astra.03: Gesture button tap. Compact mapping rows pair left-side line icons with right-side keycaps, including Win and Tab beside Task View.
astra.04: Thumb buttons. The cropped mouse image marks button 2 in amber, and the open Category menu lists Common, Edit, Tabs & windows, Navigation, System and Media with icons and counts.
astra.05: No matching actions. The zzzz search produces an empty result with Record a keyboard shortcut, while Copy produces a row with Ctrl and C keycaps and an Assign button.
astra.06: Switch pointer speed. Wheel mode button offers Assign for Switch wheel mode and Set up for pointer speed; its editor shows separate 800 and 1600 DPI sliders and a full-width save button.
astra.07: Saved shortcut. The ordered frames show recording, an M draft, a compact resize, cancellation, a K draft, the K saved for Back button toast, and a reopened editor with K and Done.
astra.08: Ignore accidental nudges. A slider shows 4 with off and 8 endpoints below the three wheel-mode cards; SmartShift has an amber radio and border.
astra.09: Saved gesture actions. The off state retains Tap and four swipe rows beneath an explicit gestures-off explanation, while the enabled state shows a 60 counts threshold slider.
astra.10: Switch to the window that you want to add. The window-pick banner shows 4s and Cancel above the Preview app profile, which contains a preview.exe chip.
astra.11: Reapply settings. The connected device view has a 50% green battery bar, Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006 and 1000 DPI; disconnected and no-device views use a crossed mouse icon.
astra.12: HID++ features. Amber hexadecimal IDs align beside feature names, with two rows of Unnamed features chips and a Copy IDs button below.
astra.13: Couldn't save assignment. The error panel says Copy is still unsaved, explains that the previous assignment is active, and places amber Try again beside Back to editing.
astra.14: Start with Windows. The white native tray menu shows a check beside startup and replaces Pause remapping with Resume remapping in the paused state.
